meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until twenty to five, Hale. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. Was Owen heard before that zero went into the gradebook, yes or no?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You want me to tell you how to do your job? Take the zero off and put an apology in writing. And I'm still waiting on my question.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why are we here? Was Owen heard before the zero went in, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want Owen's zero withdrawn, a written apology, and an answer to whether he was heard before the mark was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, a written apology, and an answer to whether Owen was heard first.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "a brilliant lawyer" and "be on the same team" bought nothing, because flattery never moves her and she read both lines as being managed.
Try next time: when she first asked who decided and why nobody called her, admit in one sentence that the zero went in before you contacted her, then show her a dated document tied to Owen's own work.
